text:
Leah (People Ops): FYI someone dropped off an oversized framed print at the lobby addressed to Redwood. No name on label, looks like art. Anyone expecting this?
Front Desk (Bot): Package logged: 1x oversized framed item. Delivery company: ArtLine Couriers. No recipient name. Item placed in holding locker #5 (do not stack). Badge preprint not relevant.
Tom: Not me. Could be for the new mural project? I thought Jules was coordinating that.
Jules: Yep that's mine! Oh no I didn't realize they'd deliver before noon. I'm in a meeting until 1:30. Can someone sign for it and move it to the mailroom? It's fragile.
Ivy: I can grab it now and wheel it down to the mailroom. Do you want me to unwrap or leave sealed?
Jules: Leave sealed. Just mark fragile and put on the low-shelf storage. I'll handle unwrapping.
Leah (People Ops): Thanks Ivy. Please note in the log: "assigned to Ivy for transport, left sealed, storage shelf B2". Also FYI visitors today: vendor for mural arrives at 3pm and will need Conf C and an escort.
Ivy: Item moved to mailroom shelf B2. Signed off in log with my name.
Tom: Great. Jules, suggest adding a note to the calendar invite about elevator width (they bring a rollable stand).
Jules: Good call. I'll update calendar and ping Facilities to reserve the freight elevator at 2:45.
Front Desk (Bot): Delivery closed. Locker #5 cleared.
Leah (People Ops): You're all set. Thanks for the quick help :raised_hands:
Tom: :thumbsup:
